title: Feature-wise PLE before the shared recurrent encoder

source_basis.paper: Gorishniy et al., On Embeddings for Numerical Features, https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.05556
source_basis.implementation_note: Project-authored quantile PLE recipe; not an exact paper reproduction.

intervention: Before the existing GRU input projection, replace each standardized raw scalar by eight cumulative linear ramps over up to nine unique, bounded-sample training quantiles and retain its unbounded standardized raw coordinate. Pass the existing 99 event features through unchanged.
control: Equal-width feature map with the same learned outer projection, GRU and head; only each raw scalar bypass is active and its eight ramp coordinates are zero.
effective_capacity_note: Allocated parameter counts match, but the 896 zero control ramp coordinates make the connected input-projection weights ineffective for data-dependent fitting.
assumptions: Feature-wise scalar response geometry can help before temporal mixing.
The anonymous raw feature order is stable; no physical depth or quote semantics are inferred.
Clamped basis coordinates plus a raw bypass preserve information outside the fitting quantile range.
observable: On identical component-complete fitting/evaluation membership, seed and update budget, PLE changes official global_wp_clip2_v1 more than the linear-map control; a later matched ordinary MLP control separates geometry from generic nonlinear capacity.
cheapest_discriminating_test: Manual knot/tie/sentinel/range and reload checks, causal full/chunk/stream parity, then one profiled single-seed small-data GPU pair.
falsifier: The declared PLE recipe is invalid if any knot depends on evaluation membership, a raw value outside the knot range is lost, fitted buffers fail reload, or streaming/full outputs disagree. A small noisy score alone does not refute the broader H234 family.
estimated_cost: One 10% complete-component fit subset, one seed per arm, one full fixed epoch after actual-device profiling; E537's 20 GPU-minute pair was a proposal, not a measured cost or spending authorization.
execution_owner: root assigns profile and GPU operator
next_descendant_if_informative: A separately registered parameter-matched ordinary input MLP control to distinguish PLE geometry from generic nonlinear active capacity; do not attribute a future PLE gain solely to geometry.
